text:
Seven places around Shinjuku Station,
one for every hour of the day 👇

🍜 Breakfast
Kameya, West Exit: soba from 6:20.
About ¥600. Closed Sundays. Cash only.

🥢 Lunch
Fuunji, South Exit: tsukemen ¥1,000.
It closes when the soup runs out.
Go at 11:00.

🍛 Dinner
Manna at Nakamuraya, East Exit.
The curry has been served since 1927.

🌙 After midnight
Nagi in Golden Gai: open 24 hours.
Ten seats up a steep staircase.

💴 Three of the seven take no cards.

👉 All 7 picks by exit:
